name: walked-module-leaves-out-node-modules
description: A target whose root holds no module file is every module below it, and the packages of each are its own directories outside the directories the Go program leaves out. A sentinel module beside an npm project holds no package of its own, so the Go file a package manager installed below its node_modules directory is no package of the target and nothing in it is reported, while the other module's dead function is.
